seo.metaTitle: Careers | Brand Manager and Junior PPC Specialist | eCom Gliders
seo.metaDescription: Join eCom Gliders in-house Amazon team. Open roles: Brand Manager and Junior PPC Specialist. Remote with US business-hours collaboration. Apply on this page.

hero.title: Two seats on an in-house Amazon bench
hero.subtitle: eCom Gliders hires selectively for craft that ships inside the agency—not a revolving freelance marketplace. We currently have two open roles.
hero.forLine: For: candidates who want to own Amazon brand or advertising work with an in-house team serving US, UK, Canada, and EU sellers.
hero.notForLine: Not for: agencies seeking capacity (use Agency Partnership), brands seeking services (use Free Audit), or vendors pitching tools to eCom Gliders.

bench.heading: In-house Amazon delivery, not a reseller network
bench.intro: PPC, listings, catalog, creative, and account work are run by eCom Gliders specialists. That matters for how you learn, how work is reviewed, and who owns the client outcome.

items.title: One team, clear lanes
items.description: Brand Managers coordinate strategy and client communication. PPC specialists run advertising craft. Creative and catalog sit beside you—not behind an opaque vendor layer.

items.title: Client work with accountability
items.description: You support real Seller Central and Ads Console work across marketplaces. Recommendations are expected to be specific, measured, and ready for client conversation.

items.title: Remote with a shared clock
items.description: Roles are remote. Collaboration aligns with US business hours so account reviews, ads changes, and handoffs stay predictable.

openRoles.heading: Two positions are open now
openRoles.intro: Both roles are full-time. Work is remote with collaboration during US business hours. Read the role craft below, then apply once with the role picker.

roles.title: Brand Manager
roles.locationLine: Remote — collaboration during US business hours
roles.summary: Own client relationships and account strategy for Amazon brands. Coordinate PPC, listings, creative, and catalog so delivery stays on plan.
outcomes: Primary client contact for assigned accounts
Clear weekly priorities across the pod
Performance narratives clients can act on
roles.about: The Brand Manager is the strategic lead for a portfolio of Amazon accounts. You protect retention through proactive communication, translate marketplace data into plans, and keep cross-functional work aligned without losing the client relationship.
responsibilities: Own client communication for assigned accounts—calls, updates, and escalation handling
Build and maintain account plans covering sales, advertising efficiency, listing health, and catalog risk
Coordinate with PPC, creative, and catalog specialists so deliverables land on time and on strategy
Review reports and decks before they reach the client; present insights in plain language
Flag underperformance early and bring specific next steps, not vague status summaries
Maintain task hygiene in the team’s project tools after meetings and ad-hoc requests
mustHaves: Hands-on familiarity with Amazon Seller Central and brand growth levers (listings, ads, catalog basics)
Experience owning client or stakeholder communication in an agency, brand, or ecommerce setting
Comfort reading sales, conversion, and advertising metrics and turning them into recommendations
Strong written English and structured meeting habits
Ability to prioritize across multiple accounts without dropping follow-ups
niceToHaves: Prior Amazon agency Brand Manager or Account Manager experience
Exposure to Brand Analytics, Helium 10, or similar research tools

roles.title: Junior PPC Specialist
roles.locationLine: Remote — collaboration during US business hours
roles.summary: Support Sponsored Products, Brands, and Display work under senior guidance. Research keywords, keep campaigns tidy, and report what the numbers actually say.
outcomes: Clean campaign hygiene on assigned accounts
Keyword and search-term research that informs bids
Clear weekly performance notes for the Brand Manager
roles.about: The Junior PPC Specialist grows into Amazon advertising craft inside a real client pod. You will not own strategy alone on day one—you will execute, measure, and learn with senior review so ACOS, CTR, and spend stay intentional.
responsibilities: Assist with setup, monitoring, and optimization of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display
Run keyword and search-term research; propose negatives and bid adjustments for review
Track daily budgets and flag overspend or stalled campaigns early
Analyze CTR, CPC, ACOS, and ROAS; write concise notes for the Brand Manager
Keep advertising console structures organized and documented
Stay current on Amazon Ads console changes that affect day-to-day optimization
mustHaves: Basic understanding of PPC or digital advertising concepts
Comfort with Excel or Google Sheets for sorting, filtering, and simple analysis
Clear written English and willingness to document work
Coachable attitude in a fast-paced, feedback-heavy environment
Reliable remote setup suitable for US-hours collaboration
niceToHaves: 1+ year Amazon Advertising Console or Seller Central exposure
Familiarity with Helium 10, Data Dive, or similar keyword tools
Prior ecommerce or marketplace internship or junior role

process.heading: From application to decision
process.intro: We keep the process short. Incomplete applications may be declined without a call.

steps.title: Apply
steps.description: Submit the form with role, LinkedIn, resume URL, and a short note on relevant Amazon work.

steps.title: Review
steps.description: We screen for Amazon touchpoints, communication quality, and role fit. Expect a reply within about two business days.

steps.title: Conversation
steps.description: A structured call covers experience, tools, and how you work with clients or campaign data.

steps.title: Decision
steps.description: We confirm scope, collaboration hours, and next steps. We only advance candidates we can support well.

fit.heading: Who we hire—and who we pass
fit.intro: A small in-house team stays effective when new seats raise the craft bar.

hire.heading: We typically hire
items: People with real Amazon or ecommerce execution—not only generic marketing theory
Writers and analysts who explain tradeoffs clearly
Candidates who document work and follow through on deadlines
Juniors who are coachable, and Brand Managers who own the client relationship

pass.heading: We typically pass
items: Applications with no LinkedIn or resume URL and no Amazon context
Vendor or freelance pitches using this form as a sales inbox
Agency partnership requests (use the Agency Partnership page)
Brand service inquiries (use Free Audit or Contact)

items.question: Are these roles remote?
items.answer: Yes. Both roles are remote with collaboration during US business hours so client and pod work stays aligned.

items.question: Do I need prior Amazon agency experience?
items.answer: Brand Manager applicants should bring Amazon marketplace familiarity and client-facing ownership. Junior PPC Specialist applicants need PPC fundamentals and coachability; console experience is preferred but not always required.

items.question: What tools will I use?
items.answer: Day-to-day work centers on Amazon Seller Central and the Advertising Console, plus spreadsheets and the team’s project and communication tools. Specific stacks are confirmed during interviews.

items.question: I run an agency. Should I apply here?
items.answer: No. Complementary agencies should use the Agency Partnership page. This form is for people joining the eCom Gliders team.

items.question: How fast do you reply?
items.answer: We aim to respond within about two business days. Incomplete applications may take longer or be declined.

application.heading: Apply for an open role
application.intro: Select the role, share LinkedIn and a resume or portfolio URL, and tell us about your Amazon experience. We review for fit before scheduling a call.
application.successMessage: Thanks — your application is in. Our hiring team typically replies within about two business days when there is a fit.
application.errorMessage: Please check the highlighted fields on your application and try again.
application.consentLabel: I agree to the privacy policy and consent to being contacted about this application.

close.heading: Selective by design
close.body: If one of the open roles matches your craft, apply above. For agency collaboration use Agency Partnership. For brand Amazon help use Free Audit or Contact.
